webhook.instructions: Your systems send a POST with {{payload}} to the webhook URL, and each delivery appears here as a bot message.
webhook.embedInstructions: For a richer alert, send embeds: up to 5 cards with title, description, color ({{colors}}…), fields, url, footer, and timestamp — the same format as Discord.
webhook.hiddenUrl: The URL only appears when it is created. If you no longer have it, generate a new one.
webhook.rotateFailed: Could not generate a new URL. Try again.
webhook.confirmDescription: The current URL stops working immediately. Systems sending to this bot must receive the new one.

reveal.warning: Copy the URL now: it will not be shown again. If you lose it, generate another one in the bot settings.
